name: jira-board
description: A live Jira board in a pane beside the chat: columns, cards, issue details and status moves, through your connected Atlassian MCP server.

site.title: Jira site
site.description: Your Atlassian site's hostname, as in its URLs (yourcompany.atlassian.net). Required.

project.title: Project key
project.description: The key of the project whose board is drawn (the PROJ in PROJ-123). Required.

boardId.title: Board id
boardId.description: The board's number in its URL, for the Open in Jira link. Empty links to the project instead.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Statuses in board order, comma-separated. Empty orders the statuses found by category (to do, in progress, done).

doneDays.title: Days of Done
doneDays.description: How many days back the Done column reaches. 0 hides finished work.

jql.title: Extra JQL
jql.description: A clause ANDed onto the board's query, e.g. labels = frontend.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often an open board re-reads Jira. Nothing is fetched while the pane is closed.

openOnStart.title: Open on session start
openOnStart.description: Open the board when a session starts. It docks only where the terminal is wide enough; /jira opens it anywhere.

mcpServer.title: Atlassian MCP server
mcpServer.description: The MCP server to read Jira through, as /mcp names it. Empty finds whichever connected server has the Jira search tool.
